Exact ↔ Decimal (S⇔D)

Toggle between exact forms (fractions, surds, π multiples) and decimal approximations.

keys
S⇔D

Example

  1. 48​ = exact surd form
  2. S⇔D → decimal
note

Fraction style (ab/c vs d/c) is controlled in SET UP and affects how fractional exact results present.
